YOUR MAJESTY

KING MIMIC

Choose Gnaw (20 Hunger, 8 damage) or Devour (100 Hunger, 25 damage). Only a killing bite captures an essence.

TACTICAL COMMAND

Build your command chain

Play up to five chain slots. Stack up to three identical recruit cards into one slot. Goblins swarm, Skeletons yield Bones, Spiders weave webs, Slimes divide, and Mimiclings lure invaders. Choose a lane before resolving; summoned minions fight and protect your veterans.

NEW MONSTER FAMILIES

Creatures of the dungeon

Unlock Spider, Slime, and Mimicling summon cards from the Quartermaster's Creature Menagerie after a raid. Each family introduces a different combat mechanic.

PERSISTENT ARMY

Your defenders

Your veterans gain experience and persist between raids. All summoned creatures are disposable and vanish between raids. Your permanent veterans keep their levels, HP and experience.
